2608.24715.title: Deep Learning Super Resolution for Satellite Cloud Mask Downscaling
2608.24715.paper_summary: A vast amount of optical satellite data is being transmitted to Earth-based servers every day, and more than half of this data is affected by haze or clouds. Additionally, this data suffers from the fundamental trade-off between spatial and temporal resolution, which remains largely unresolved, making the acquisition of continuous high-resolution satellite observations of clouds an ongoing challenge. This work addresses this challenge by proposing two Deep Learning super-resolution methods for the accurate downscaling of SEVIRI cloud mask products, as well as a novel cross-sensor cloud mask dataset called SEVMOD-CM, created by spatially and temporally matching MODIS and SEVIRI satellite observations. The two proposed models are a CNN-based (SpatialCNN) and a GAN-based (SpatialGAN) Neural Network. Trained on the SEVIRI spectral and cloud mask products, the proposed methods predict the corresponding MODIS Cloud masks, achieving a 4x spatial enhancement across sensor domains. Both approaches are evaluated experimentally, and compared against the standard bicubic interpolation upsampling technique. The experimental results demonstrate the value of the proposed models and dataset for the remote sensing community, highlighting the benefits of applying super-resolution techniques to geostationary-derived cloud mask products for applications such as atmospheric monitoring, weather forecasting, disaster risk reduction, solar energy forecasting, and climate research.
2608.24715.paper_summary_zh: 每天都有大量的光學衛星數據被傳輸到地面伺服器，而這些數據中有超過一半受到霧霾或雲層的影響。<lb/>此外，這些數據面臨著空間解析度和時間解析度之間的基本權衡，這一問題在很大程度上仍未解決，使得獲取連續的高解析度雲層衛星觀測成為一個持續的挑戰。<lb/>本研究通過提出兩種深度學習超解析度方法來解決這一挑戰，以準確地對SEVIRI雲掩模產品進行下採樣，並創建了一個名為SEVMOD-CM的新型跨傳感器雲掩模數據集，該數據集通過空間和時間匹配MODIS和SEVIRI衛星觀測而成。<lb/>所提出的兩個模型分別是基於CNN的(SpatialCNN)和基於GAN的(SpatialGAN)神經網絡。<lb/>這些方法在SEVIRI光譜和雲掩模產品上進行訓練，預測相應的MODIS雲掩模，實現了跨傳感器領域的4倍空間增強。<lb/>兩種方法均進行了實驗評估，並與標準的雙三次插值上採樣技術進行比較。<lb/>實驗結果展示了所提出的模型和數據集對遙感社群的價值，突顯了將超解析度技術應用於靜止衛星衍生的雲掩模產品的好處，適用於大氣監測、天氣預報、災害風險減少、太陽能預測和氣候研究等應用。
